text: The authors build a dataset of QA (counter-)explanations by having human writers read a long passage and construct an argument with supporting evidence for one of two answer options, after which the two explanations are shown side by side to a human judge under a strict time constraint who selects which answer is correct.
title: Single-turn debate protocol: arguments for each of two options shown side by side to a timed judge
